name: Conceptual Physics Bank Authoring Quality Profile
purpose: Prevent technically valid but generic/template-driven Physics Banks while preserving useful repetition and source-grounded conceptual richness.
authority_note: Original Assessment Plan owns learning/evidence. bank_course_profile owns Physics response mix/counts/representation/source behavior. Base Bank PM owns universal mechanics.

source_grounding.rule: source_basis names only sources actually consulted; framework/Assessment Plan-only is acceptable for straightforward items. Do not cite a source family mechanically on every item.
source_grounding.provenance_rule: Record only sources actually consulted for that item. Do not mechanically list the Bank profile, framework, or Hewitt family profile on every item as if they were item-level source evidence.

natural_language.rule: Prompts sound like high-school Physics: concrete, precise, compact, and physically meaningful. Context earns its place by affecting the model/quantity/decision.
avoid: generic “explain your reasoning” tails on most items
formula-hunting prompts with no physical model
college-level abstraction imported from advanced references
adding an irrelevant mass/time/distance only to create superficial variation
contradictory state descriptions such as moving at steady speed while at rest
mechanical a/an or noun substitutions that produce unnatural Physics contexts
natural_language.hard_rule: Physics prompts must describe one physically coherent situation in natural high-school language. Reject contradictory states, impossible object/setup combinations created by noun substitution, and obvious article/grammar errors.

representations.rule: Use actual diagrams/graphs/data/tables/models when they carry the evidence job. In representation-heavy sections, a text-only bank requires explicit rationale after source visual inspection.
representations.hard_rule: NEVER SHOW THE ANSWER IN THE STUDENT IMAGE. Inspect the actual visual against the exact prompt before use; source/reusable figures are not automatically student-safe.
representations.representation_required_rule: If the exact I-can/evidence job requires a representation, use the actual representation in the canonical item and secure form. Prose that merely says “a diagram shows...” does not satisfy a diagram-reading I-can.
representations.anti_avoidance: Do not respond to answer-neutrality by deleting figures. Create an answer-neutral student figure and keep the representation evidence.
representations.inline_svg_rule: Inline SVG is a real student representation and must carry the same explicit answer-neutrality QA metadata as file-backed figures through a structured figures[] metadata record (render_mode=inline_svg permitted with no file).

distractors.rule: Each wrong choice comes from a plausible misconception/error for that exact item. Equivalent correct choices are prohibited.

security.rule: Secure formative/Summative items are semantically independent of exposed instructional items across givens, figure/data, reasoning action, response type, and misconception target.
security.hard_rule: No secure item may exactly duplicate any instructional or other secure prompt. Within V1-V6, each item is independently authored; number swaps/order changes alone do not establish semantic independence.
security.semantic_clone_rule: Same stem architecture with only changed object, number, unit, or answer-choice order is not a new secure item. Same-day forms may share the concept but need genuinely different stimuli/representations/reasoning structures; V5/V6 must be more distinct.
security.exit_destination_rule: Physics Exit Tickets are formative-secure by destination. A weaker security_level string cannot bypass semantic-independence QA.

quantitative.rule: Use natural values/units and source-supported problem archetypes; vary what is given/asked and representation. Large/awkward values only when a real context or learning goal justifies them.
quantitative.priority_rule: If an I-can naturally requires formula/quantitative application, plan meaningful quantitative evidence before generic conceptual/vocabulary filler.
quantitative.reverse_rule: Vary the unknown/given direction when the relationship supports it; do not train one fixed solve direction.
quantitative.multistep_rule: Multi-step requires a dependent intermediate result. Keep compatible units unless conversion is the target.

practice_repetition.rule: Purposefully repeat families, not finished questions. Exact literal copies are prohibited by default; change meaningful evidence features. A non-secure exact repeat requires an explicit intentional_exact_repeat_reason. Secure exact repeats are forbidden.
practice_repetition.plan_stage: Use the full I-can map to design variation before authoring rather than filling counts with cloned prompts.
practice_repetition.numeric_shells: Heavy number-only/unit-only variants of one shell are review-worthy; vary representation, givens/unknown, context, misconception, or reasoning action when the I-can supports it.
practice_repetition.semantic_clone_rule: After normalizing numbers, units, and generic object nouns, large clusters of one prompt shell indicate generator cloning. Redesign the family mix rather than cosmetically rewriting after generation.

final_package_integrity: Every exact Unit I-can appears in unit{U}_i_can_map.csv and satisfies the I-can-first destination coverage floors
All canonical IDs are present in HTML/data/mapping routes
Every referenced figure exists; true orphan figures removed
NEVER show the answer in a student image; every figure is visually checked against the exact prompt and carries required answer-neutrality metadata
No visible PM/Bank/source metadata in student prompts
MathJax repaired using current Framework tool before ZIP
Canonical Bank JSON satisfies contracts/bank_handoff_contract.json literal per-item schema, including item-level dok/evidence_point_id/security_level/tables/figures/supporting_i_can_ids
Representation-explicit I-cans contain actual representation evidence; answer-neutrality never becomes image avoidance
No high-confidence physical contradictions or systematic Mad-Lib grammar defects remain
No fixed Practice allocation signature is reused across sections as a generic I-can weighting template
Every canonical item has valid audit_status; fresh builds initialize all items to NEEDS AUDIT and teacher Bank cards display status plus exact I-can text
unit{U}_question_design_map.json exists and every canonical item links to one planned slot through question_design
question_family_id values are semantic; Summative version/question numbers are not used to manufacture unique families
Physics Exit Ticket destination receives formative-secure semantic-independence QA regardless of security_level label
Inline SVG representations carry structured answer-neutrality QA metadata just like file-backed figures

i_can_first_authoring.hard_rule: Author and audit by exact I-can mini-bank before section totals. A healthy section is not enough if an individual I-can has weak or missing evidence.
i_can_first_authoring.unequal_counts: Allowed when justified by evidence complexity, representations, misconceptions, or transfer demand; unexplained overconcentration is a review flag.

audit_status_workflow.hard_rule: Builder QA does not auto-promote audit status. Every fresh canonical item remains NEEDS AUDIT until a later content audit dispositions it.
audit_status_workflow.reset_after_material_edit: Return the revised item to NEEDS AUDIT.

question_design_map.hard_rule: The exact-I-can question-design map and unitN_question_design_map.json exist before final prompt authoring. Questions are authored from planned slots, not generated first and classified later.
question_design_map.variety_rule: Map purposeful variety from the I-can. Standard/Inverted/Context-rich are wording profiles, not quotas. Vocabulary directions, quantitative/reverse directions, multi-step chains, representations, and response modes are selected only when they fit.
question_design_map.family_rule: question_family_id is semantic and stable across destinations/forms; do not append V1/Q12/Exit-B style slot tokens to manufacture uniqueness.
